mapper.select: SELECT sa.id as application_id, sa.schedule_id, j.id as job_id, j.title as job_title, sa.worker_id, w.name as worker_name, w.phone as worker_phone, js.schedule_date, js.start_time, js.end_time, sa.status, sa.applied_at FROM schedule_applications sa JOIN job_schedules js ON sa.schedule_id = js.id JOIN jobs j ON js.job_id = j.id LEFT JOIN c_worker w ON sa.worker_id = w.id WHERE j.company_id = #{companyId} ORDER BY sa.applied_at DESC

SELECT sa.id as application_id, sa.schedule_id, j.id as job_id, j.title as job_title, sa.worker_id, w.name as worker_name, w.phone as worker_phone, js.schedule_date, js.start_time, js.end_time, sa.status, sa.applied_at FROM schedule_applications sa JOIN job_schedules js ON sa.schedule_id = js.id JOIN jobs j ON js.job_id = j.id LEFT JOIN c_worker w ON sa.worker_id = w.id WHERE j.id = #{jobId} ORDER BY sa.applied_at DESC

SELECT sa.id as application_id, sa.schedule_id, j.id as job_id, j.title as job_title, sa.worker_id, w.name as worker_name, w.phone as worker_phone, js.schedule_date, js.start_time, js.end_time, sa.status, sa.applied_at FROM schedule_applications sa JOIN job_schedules js ON sa.schedule_id = js.id JOIN jobs j ON js.job_id = j.id LEFT JOIN c_worker w ON sa.worker_id = w.id WHERE j.id = #{jobId} AND sa.status = #{status} ORDER BY sa.applied_at DESC
